comments.author: @Glyn-r
comments.text: Another amazing place.  There is something about surviving in isolation that appeals to me. You answered the question that was on my mind as well. What happens if a tourist finds gold .who does it belong too.  Obviously, even a town this small cannot exist without rules.  Only thing still on my mind now is which came first. Chicken or the golden egg. 🥚

replies.author: @johnganshow5536
replies.text: @themaps26 If a tourist finds gold on public land ( BLM ) they can keep it, if they find it on someone's claim they can't...

replies.author: @TravelBeyond4K
replies.text: It is such a fascinating lifestyle. I also found the gold mining rules really interesting, though I think the question about the chicken and the egg might remain a mystery forever.

replies.author: @themaps26
replies.text: Thank you so much! There’s definitely a unique magic in how communities adapt to living in complete isolation. Glad the video answered your question
